hypotheses.S1_dynamic_sites_beat_fixed_reads: For every target-boundary cell, the best dynamic-site chart exceeds the best matched fixed-site chart by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.S2_dynamic_sites_approach_joint: A dynamic-site chart is within 0.10 of joint rank 128 in at least half of target-boundary cells.
hypotheses.S3_dynamic_reads_are_nonlocal: At least 25% of selected top-8 sites lie more than seven tokens before the next scored position.
hypotheses.S4_selected_sites_are_sampling_stable: The median top-8 site Jaccard overlap between independent Fisher sketches is at least 0.50 at every boundary.
hypotheses.S5_joint_still_has_nonseparable_advantag: The unrestricted joint chart exceeds every dynamic-site chart by at least 0.10 in at least one cell.
